findings: Built-in profile has 20 categories, all enabled, with unique IDs/folder names and no unsafe folder components or confidence-range violations. This validates the bundled data only, not imported or edited profiles.

Extension mappings are classification policy, not decoder support. Includes env/.env and sqlite-wal rules, but FileScanner skips hidden files, so .env classification example is not proof actual hidden-file discovery.
Default profile has fewer than the AI 51-category cap; custom profiles may exceed it. Keyword overlap/substrings can still affect subject classification despite unique extension mappings.
